commit.message:
Reset computed cache on cleanStores (#400)

computed() stores cached their previous arguments, epoch and value in a
closure, but never defined a [clean] handler. As a result cleanStores()
only reset the underlying atom's listeners, leaving the computed value
stale between tests. Define $computed[clean] to clear the cached state so
the value is recomputed after cleanStores().

Closes #323

Co-authored-by: ATOM00blue <219721791+ATOM00blue@users.noreply.github.com>

@@ -151,6 +152,29 @@ test('allows to call multiple times', () => {
   deepStrictEqual(events, ['loaded', 'built 1', 'built 2'])
 })
 
+test('resets computed cache', () => {
+  let multiplier = 2
+  let computations = 0
+  let $source = atom(1)
+  let $computed = computed($source, value => {
+    computations += 1
+    return value * multiplier
+  })
+
+  let unbind = $computed.subscribe(() => {})
+  equal($computed.get(), 2)
+  equal(computations, 1)
+  unbind()
+
+  cleanStores($source, $computed)
+
+  multiplier = 10
+  let unbind2 = $computed.subscribe(() => {})
+  equal($computed.get(), 10)
+  equal(computations, 2)
+  unbind2()
+})
+
